description: Defines the OA_Dll_VariableInfo class, which manages variable metadata for the Revive Adserver, including default values, data types, and conversion methods.

classes.name: OA_Dll_VariableInfo
classes.description: A class representing variable metadata within the Revive Adserver, including data types, purposes, and methods for setting defaults and data conversion.

methods.name: setDefaultForAdd
methods.description: Sets default values for optional fields when adding a new variable.

methods.name: getFieldsTypes
methods.description: Returns an array describing the data types of the class properties.

methods.name: getDataObjectArray
methods.description: Returns an array suitable for updating a data object with the variable's data.

methods.name: setVariableDataFromArray
methods.description: Populates the object properties from an array of variable data.
